content.short: AgorApp provides a one-stop platform for learning Web3 development: learn, compete, and build.
content.description: AgorApp provides an agnostic IDE for Web3 learning, delivering a Codecademy-style, interactive curriculum across multiple chains and protocols. The platform lets users dive into courses and tutorials, and tackle gas-optimization challenges to apply what they learn. Partners include NEAR, Internet Computer, Lisk, and Ethereum Swarm, with a plan to onboard additional chains and protocols in 2024. Learners gain practical, hands-on experience across diverse ecosystems through structured lessons and exercises.
content.meta: AgorApp has built an agnostic IDE for Web3 learning. Discover AgorApp and other Web3 Developer Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.tldr: An interactive IDE for learning Web3 engineering by writing code rather than reading about it. The case for practice-first in a docs-heavy field.
